summary: Frontend-only testing of new /berita news page. Verified Landing 'Lihat Selengkapnya' navigates to /berita, direct URL loads, category filter (9 categories) works (Pengumuman -> 1 card), search reduces cards and triggers empty state on no match, empty state shows correctly, mobile 390px viewport has no horizontal overflow, and existing CMS-driven announcement cards render (banner placeholder, category tag, title, summary, date badge, external link). Existing announcement flow on landing page untouched.

issues: Hardcoded categories list does not include 'Informasi' which is used by the seeded CMS announcement; the card is still reachable via 'Semua Berita' but not directly filterable via sidebar. Consider deriving categories from announcements or aligning admin CMS options with sidebar list.

action_items: Optional: sync category taxonomy between admin CMS (announcement.category) and NewsPage sidebar so every announcement can be filtered by clicking a sidebar item (currently 'Informasi' category exists in data but not in sidebar).
critical_code_review_comments: NewsPage.jsx is a single very long JSX line; consider breaking into components for readability and reuse (NewsCard, CategorySidebar).
Banner URL is concatenated with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only when item.banner?.url is relative; no guard if url is already absolute. Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: NewsPage at /berita is working end-to-end with CMS content. Only minor taxonomy mismatch between announcement.category ('Informasi') and sidebar list.
